key_strengths: Q1 decomposes a subjective route-experience concept into explicit visibility, temporal surprise, spatial difference and Pareto route objectives
Q1 printed code actually uses -log(probability) for temporal surprise, which is semantically consistent with low-probability=high-surprise even though Eq.(4) prose/formula uses raw p
Q1 keeps two objectives rather than collapsing route interest and repeat length into one hidden weight
Q2 combines patch ecology, morphology and space-syntax evidence and provides rich diagnostic figures
Q3 explicitly organizes micro/meso/macro features and separates expert/network/spatial/abstract similarity components before fusion
key_risks: Q1 Eq.(4) writes LD=0.5*p+0.5*d while the surrounding text defines lower transition probability as higher surprise; printed code instead uses -log(p). This is a paper-formula/code semantic contract drift.

Q1 mathematical constraint states 2<=n<=100, yet the reported Pareto paths span 30-222 nodes. Printed code limits step_choices to <100 but shortest-path bridging can extend the decoded path and evaluate() has no final <=100 feasibility gate.

Q1 reports HV=0.4884, then later describes Hypervolume coverage >=90% without a visible normalization/reference-point contract; GD is said to approach a theoretical optimal front whose provenance is not established in the visible method.

Q1 turning-density correlation is not an independent perceptual validation: route geometry/turning and the constructed anomaly/network representation share structure; correlation supports association, not model correctness.
Q1 printed visibility code treats only 实体建筑 as a full occluder; this is a concrete implementation assumption that should not be generalized to all gardens without sensitivity checks.

Q2 scores use the same ten gardens to define min/max and additionally force Jichang Garden indicators to 100, then use agreement with Jichang Garden being best as validation. This is anchor-target circular calibration, not independent validation.

Q2 AI is reported correlated 0.99 with connectivity/IIC while the text claims the indicator system avoids highly redundant indicators; near-collinearity requires redundancy analysis rather than semantic assertion alone.

Q3 n=10/11 gardens but d=179 features, weighted cosine similarities are all >0.85 and mean about 0.985-0.986; this may reflect high-dimensional/normalization concentration and does not by itself validate cultural universality.

Q3 KMeans uses the same high-dimensional features to create clusters and one-way ANOVA on those same features is then used as significance evidence. This is post-selection/double-dipping, not independent cluster validation.

Q3 reports CV=0 for some features while the personality index divides by feature standard deviation; a zero-variance guard is required. Printed analyzer bodies are not visible enough to verify that guard.
Q3 printed feature engineering contains explicit hand-selection/reallocation such as “为了凑够116维”, so dimension completion is an engineering convention, not learned evidence of semantic sufficiency.
Q3 broad exception fallbacks can silently turn PCA/KMeans failures into plausible zero/default feature vectors, masking pipeline failure.
recommended_redo: Q1 keep transparent visibility/change metrics, but define temporal surprise consistently as -log(p) or 1-p, impose path constraints after every decode/bridge, and compare Pareto quality with a declared reference set/reference point plus user/perceptual validation.

Q2 keep interpretable ecology/morphology descriptors but fit normalization/directions/weights on a development subset or external expert criterion; do not force the evaluation anchor to 100 before validating the ranking; collapse/reweight near-collinear indicators.

Q3 with only 10-11 independent gardens, start from a compact interpretable descriptor and leave-one-garden/external validation. Treat autoencoder/KMeans as exploratory; use stability/resampling or external labels instead of same-feature ANOVA to validate clusters.

Across all questions, attach uncertainty/sensitivity to hand-set thresholds, weights and visibility assumptions and ensure Result Registry distinguishes construction metrics from independent evidence.
